subject: Post-demo: RAG readiness, model & reranker recommendations (Horizon Health)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@horizonhealth.com>, ds@horizonhealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: RAG readiness, model & reranker recommendations (Horizon Health)

Hi Samantha / Horizon team —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can qualify a short pilot: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Clinical search assistant: prioritize high attribution and low hallucination for patient-facing summaries.
- Mixed docs: PDFs + EHR export CSVs; average doc chunk ~600 tokens.
- SLA: 95th pct latency < 650ms for single-turn lookups; throughput modest (peak ~8 qps).

Redwood recommendations (initial)
1) Model candidates to evaluate (start A/B):
   - RW-7B-8q (low-cost baseline; fast tokens)
   - RW-13B-v1 (balanced quality/cost — primary candidate)
   - RW-13B-rafined-med (option if we need clinical phrasing fidelity)

2) Retrieval settings we suggest for the pilot:
   - Embedding: semantic-512-v2 (good med-domain recall)
   - Chunk size: 512-token sliding window, 50% overlap for PDFs
   - Recall target: recall@5 > 0.85 on canonical Q set
3) Reranker shortlist:
   - Lightweight bi-encoder re-ranking (fast) for 95th pct latency target
   - Cross-encoder pass for top-3 when attribution confidence < 0.7 (fallback)
4) Grounding & metrics to track: attribution rate (source cited), hallucination rate (false facts per 100 answers), exact-match on canonical snippet retrieval, latency p95, quality regression (BLEU/F1 over prompt-suite).

Deliverables we can put together by next Wed (May 12):
- small benchmark run (10k Qs) across RW-7B-8q and RW-13B-v1 with retrieval v1 (I will attach CSV)
- prompt suite (attached) + recommended evaluation script
- a short config file for Redwood Dedicated that reflects the latency SLOs

Ask for you: can Horizon share a small (anonymized) sample of ~200 representative queries + 50 gold passages for initial recall checks? That will shorten qualification.

Attachments: horizon_benchmarks_v1.csv (seeded test set), prompt_suite_horizon_v2.zip

Next steps / owners
- Ben: run initial bench and send results (ETA May 12)
- Karthik: will propose reranker options and a lightweight A/B plan (ETA May 12)
- Horizon: send sample queries / confirm timelines

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up to walk through configs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
- We can provide an anonymized sample (200 queries + gold passages) by EOD Tuesday.
- On latency: 650ms p95 is aggressive on our side as well; for patient-facing flows we'd prefer p95 < 500ms if the accuracy delta is negligible.
- Re reranker: our DS team prefers starting with a cross-encoder for quality checks, but we can experiment with the bi-encoder for scale.

Can you confirm the storage/PII controls for the pilot data if we share the sample? We need to align on retention window and KMS for keys.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@horizonhealth.com>, ds@horizonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: RAG readiness, model & reranker recommendations (Horizon Health)

Ben / Karthik —

Quick technical notes to propose for the pilot implementation (so the Horizon DS team can sign off):

1) Two-pass rerank architecture (recommended pilot flow)
   - Phase A: bi-encoder ANN (Faiss HNSW) at recall@100 to stay within latency budget for most queries.
   - Phase B: cross-encoder re-rank for top-3 when cross-encoder confidence delta > 0.12 or when user asks for "verify sources".
   - Rationale: gives deterministic p95 tail while preserving the option for a quality boost on ambiguous queries.

2) Retrieval hyperparams we will include in the config file:
   - top_k_retriever: 100 (ANN), rerank_top_k: 3, chunk_overlap: 50%
   - vector refresh cadence: nightly incremental with monthly full reindex (Horizon can tune)

3) Evaluation & regression checks
   - Gold metrics we will compute: attribution_rate, hallucination_rate (annotated sample), recall@k, answer_f1, latency_p95.
   - Baseline gating rule: if hallucination_rate increases by > 3% vs baseline on validation suite, auto-fail the rollout and alert product/CS.

4) Data security for pilot (answer to Samantha)
   - Pilot ingest will use customer-managed keys (KMS) and data retention policy set to 30 days unless Horizon requests a shorter window.
   - We will enable audit logs for all retrieval requests and token outputs for the pilot (redacted PII by default).

I'll draft the reranker A/B matrix and a short synthetic evaluation harness to run on your sample. Karthik — can you pick 2 candidate cross-encoders (one distilled, one full) and include cost estimates?

Thx,
Monica
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Thanks team — quick update and commitments: 

1) Horizon will send the anonymized sample by EOD Tuesday (confirmed).
2) Monica/Karthik: we'll deliver the A/B reranker matrix + a short cost/latency sketch by EOD today (attached in the benchmark CSV).
3) I ran an initial 2k-question sweep overnight (attached results) comparing RW-7B-8q vs RW-13B-v1 against the retrieval v1 config. Highlights:
   - RW-13B-v1 improved answer_f1 by ~6 pts and reduced hallucination_rate from 9.8% -> 4.1% on the seeded set.
   - p95 latency: RW-7B-8q = 420ms (bi-encoder only); RW-13B-v1 = 560ms (with cross-encoder top-3 rerank).

Links / artifacts
- Benchmarks: https://redwood.app/reports/HZ-3421/benchmark-v1
- Prompt suite & eval script (attached: prompt_suite_horizon_v2.zip)
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/HZ-3421

Action items (owners & dates)
- Horizon: share sample + confirm data retention/KMS (owner: Samantha; ETA Tue EOD)
- Redwood: run the A/B pilot with a full reranker matrix once sample is in (owner: Ben / Monica; ETA Fri May 14)
- Redwood infra: set pilot retention to 30 days and enable audit logs (owner: infra team; request filed)

If Horizon wants stricter retention or to host the private deployment, we can scope Redwood Private and provide an enterprise KMS flow (we should discuss budget).

If that all sounds good I'll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with the Horizon DS team for next week.

Best,
Ben
